title: Operations run as jobs a central queue places on workstation, server or CI executors
goal: Long operations run as jobs of a per-host executor that sessions submit to and follow, with recovery, serialisation, land as one job across its merge request, job stats and the sprint skill's run step submitting them; a central coord service queues the jobs of every clone for workstation, server and CI executors; each job's placement and identity come from an OPA decision over nested groups, with per-group overrides served as signed bundles and the OPA configuration printed; server and CI executors run the jobs placed on them with the identity the decision names, from worker branches pushed on demand, with paid jobs capped, an offline workstation's jobs moved to their fallback and each job's records counted once
